subject.title: improve: let Code Mode use declared tool result shapes

question: Should `outputSchema` become the supported optional plugin API for both model-visible result hints and runtime validation of `AgentToolResult.details`?
rationale: The implementation can be technically correct while still committing OpenClaw to a new third-party SDK contract and to failure semantics for opted-in tools; repository policy requires maintainer intent for that compatibility-sensitive direction.

options.title: Approve the unified contract
options.body: Accept `outputSchema` as the single optional hints-and-validation API, then merge only after exact-head CI and transcript-ordering proof pass.

options.title: Limit it to hints
options.body: Expose trusted result shapes to Code Mode and Tool Search but postpone runtime result rejection until the plugin compatibility policy is separately approved.

options.title: Pause the API
options.body: Keep outputs unknown and revisit result contracts through a narrower SDK design discussion before adding a public field.

recommendation.title: Approve the unified contract
recommendation.body: Accept `outputSchema` as the single optional hints-and-validation API, then merge only after exact-head CI and transcript-ordering proof pass.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the best available feature-history owner for routing, though final product approval must come from a qualifying maintainer because the PR is protected by the `maintainer` label.
